New Fastboot Firmware Flasher Update:
Version 1.0.2.0  
—————————
💀ATTENTION: Don't flash Android 16 yet. I haven't tested and I don't take any responsibilities for your actions!
—————————
🎉 NEW FEATURES

For OnePlus users with custom OxygenOS firmware from resellers

You no longer need to search for super or download SuperFlasher to restore the original ColorOS.  
With the new SuperBuilder function, you can quickly generate a super.img or super_empty.img, then use the SuperFlasher feature from the Firmware Flasher tab to restore the original partition layout and flash any firmware you prefer.

SuperBuilder — NEW TOOL FOR CREATING SUPER IMAGES  
A brand-new page for creating and managing super.img images with a visual interface.

Key Features:
1. Two creation modes:
•  Full Mode — super.img with full content  
•  Empty Mode — super_empty.img for partition structure only

2. Two configuration sources:
•  Manual Source — select device from database or create a custom configuration  
•  Online Source — parse metadata from ZIP (local or URL)

3. Device database management:
•  Visual editor for devices_sizes.json  
•  Add/remove configurations via UI  
•  "Delete" button on hover  
•  Custom parameters: Model Name, Super Size, Group Size, Group Name  
•  Atomic write with race condition protection (SemaphoreSlim)

4. Online metadata parser:
•  Parse info from ZIP (HTTP/HTTPS or local service archives)  
•  Extract: group names (_a/_b), sizes, device size, partition list  
•  Auto-detect device name  
•  Drag & Drop support for ZIP files

5. Partition support:
•  Filter by presence of .img files  
•  Auto-remove _a/_b suffixes  
•  Fallback to existing images  
•  Empty Mode works without files — structure only

Added models (editable):  
• OnePlus Global — 10 Pro/5G, 10R/10T, 11/11R, 12/12R, 13 NA/IN, 13R, Nord 2T/4, Nord CE 2–4 Lite, CE4, Pad Go  
• OnePlus China — 11, 12, 13, Ace 2 Pro, Ace 3/3 Pro/3V, Ace 5/5 Pro  
• realme — 9 Pro 5G, 10, GT3 240W  
• realme China — GT Neo5/240W/SE, GT Neo6/SE, GT5/Pro, GT6, GT7 Pro竞速版, Neo7 SE

---

SuperFlasher — NEW TAB IN FLASHER
A third tab added for simplified flashing via super images.

Key Features:
1. Segmented navigation:
•  Firmware Flasher (classic flashing)  
•  Super Flasher (new — flashing SUPER images)  
•  Fix FastbootD/Recovery (recovery restoration)

2. Supported super image types:
•  super.img (full image):  
 — Flash single file  
 — No need to flash each logical partition  
 — Auto-set slot _a  
•  super_empty.img (empty image):  
 — Structure only  
 — Flash all partitions from FIRMWARE/SYSTEM

3. Smart selection:
•  Auto-scan folder FIRMWARE/<name>/SUPER/  
•  Dialog when both Full and Empty images are present

4. Unified architecture

---

KernelSU Next SUSFS Patcher — During Flashing

1. New services:
•  Recursive boot.img search in firmware  
•  Auto-detect kernel version  
•  Anykernel archive source selection:  
 — From Repository — GitHub releases with dates  
 — Local — via FileOpenPicker  
•  Auto-patch with backup of original image

---

OnePlus 13 CN → Global Flashing

1. Auto-detect model  
2. Unified patch dialog:  
•  Single selection for DTBO and My_region  
•  Apply patches — use modified images  
•  Skip patches — use original images

---

Navigation Locking System

Navigation lock during flashing:  
•  Check FirmwareFlasherPage.IsFlashingActive  
•  Auto-lock menu items: Device Info, Reboot, Drivers

---

Progress & UI Improvements in "Flasher" Window

•  Cards grouped by: Super, Bootloader, Critical, System, Extra, Modem  
•  Real-time progress for each partition  
•  Statuses: Waiting, In Progress, Completed, Error

---

Firmware Unpacker — ONLINE UNPACKING

•  Updated unpacker core  
•  Displays firmware info when inserting a link  
•  Updated UI — now matches local unpacker with cards  
•  Multithreading added — significantly faster image downloads
